references.text: Introduces Achan, son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, as the one who took the devoted things
Describes the casting of lots by which the tribes and clans were brought forward, leading to Achan's exposure
Relates the punishment that fell upon Achan and his family after he was caught
Mentions Zerah as one of the sons of Judah, and Zerah's descendants, to whom Achan belonged
Gives the genealogy of Judah including Carmi and Zabdi (Shimri), the ancestors of Achan
Shows another example of casting lots to identify a guilty person, similar to the method used to find Achan
Samuel used a similar lot-casting method to choose Saul as king, tribe by tribe, clan by clan
